say:1:1430217201:1.text: Because he's a commoner... My parents are very traditional. They won't accept him.
say:1:1430217201:1.source_cn: 因为他是平民……我的父母十分守旧，他们是不会接受他的。
say:1:1430217201:1.male: Because he's a commoner... My parents are very traditional. They won't accept him.
say:1:1430217201:1.female: Because he's a commoner... My parents are very traditional. They won't accept him.

say:2:1430217202:1.text: But he's an amazing person. He even joined the guards with his own strength.
say:2:1430217202:1.source_cn: 但他很厉害，凭借自己的力量加入了卫队！
say:2:1430217202:1.male: But he's an amazing person. He even joined the guards with his own strength.
say:2:1430217202:1.female: But he's an amazing person. He even joined the guards with his own strength.
